description: Write a pandas ETL script for ecom_market that derives a change feed from two full daily snapshots of the product catalog. The script should: (1) read yesterday's and today's snapshot, (2) classify each product_id as insert (only in today), delete (only in yesterday), update (in both with any tracked column different) or unchanged, (3) output only inserts, updates and deletes with a change_type column and the new values (for deletes, the last known values), (4) compare tracked columns price, stock and description in a null-safe way. In the sample, rows are tagged with _dataset = yesterday or today.
edge_cases: p1 is unchanged: description is null in both snapshots and price '9.99' equals '9.990' numerically
A FULL OUTER merge is required; a left merge from today misses the delete of p3
stock becomes float when the outer merge introduces NaN; it must be cast back to a nullable integer
An empty or truncated 'today' snapshot would mark every product as deleted; the script must abort if today's row count drops by more than 50%
common_failure_modes: FM1: Left or inner merge drops deletes or inserts from the change feed
FM7: Null-unsafe or string-based comparison reports p1 as updated every day
FM7: No guard against an empty snapshot generating mass deletes
